title: 'Do all roads ultimately lead to Tel Aviv?'
text:
'Do all roads ultimately lead to Tel Aviv?' "

"Iran’s FM spox Baghaei questions 'who really is the true decision-maker within the US' in its Middle East policy"

"'This is a matter the United States must resolve as quickly as possible, for the sake of its own credibility and status'"

""It is not far-fetched to assume that some in the U.S. ruling administration have concluded, even if they do not say so, or some do, that America is sacrificing its wealth, credibility and standing for a party that thinks of nothing other than permanent war in our region. The Zionist regime has proven that it considers its own survival conditional on the continuation of war and bloodshed in the region.
